reasons.text: Energy charges do not match units x tariff on 100% of bills (worst bill charged 22% of expected)
Certificates claim more than the declared monthly capacity in 43% of months
Claimed tonnage in the busiest month would need 166% of the plant's connected load running non-stop (above 100% is physically impossible)
100% of certificate tonnes were sold below the cost of recycling (average 0.38x the cost floor)
66% of all certificates were generated in a single month
66% of certificate tonnes were generated more than 45 days after the processing month

model_signals.label: bills whose charges do not match units x tariff

inspection_checklist: Verify the electricity bills directly with the DISCOM (units, tariff, amount); the uploaded copies do not reconcile.
Check installed machinery and shift records against the declared capacity; request production registers for the flagged months.
Obtain the DISCOM consumption statement and meter readings for the flagged months; compare connected machinery (kW) against the claimed tonnage.
Ask for the plant's cost sheet; certificates priced below the cost of recycling imply the processing cost was never incurred.
Cross-check the certificate generation dates and category mix against the plant's process route and stock registers.
